brief.about: Courtney Acamo is a ceremonialist, healer and singer in Boulder, Colorado offering tea ceremonies, blessing ceremonies, intuitive healing sessions and vocal empowerment — in Boulder and online.
brief.audience: People seeking to slow down, heal and find their voice; they should explore the offerings and book a session or send a note.
brief.notes: Pages: Home, Offerings, About, Book a Session. Design ported from her canvas ("temple of earth & light": deep turquoise night banners, gold lettering, rose accents, arched photos). Script accent font Pinyon Script. Sessions 90 min; healing/voice $150 ($175 at home); tea $40/person or $300 in-person group at home; blessings priced by gathering. No prices on the home page. Booking requests go to courtneyacamo@gmail.com; she replies within 2–4 days. Photos are temporary placeholders, to be replaced with her own.
